method: For every one of33 core releases, remove every component of that part and retain all63 other source proxy poses. Construct complete inclusive integer free-anchor cells for both new brackets and the restored original part with the existing finite orientation inventory. For each anchor cell, the moving component swept over its continuous bounding rectangle is an outward occupied-region rectangle. Exact continuous union areas on each sheet bound all realizable occupied proxy area. Enumerate every count allocation of the two brackets and every allowed restored-part sheet; reject only by exact per-sheet required proxy areas or audited original-part area capacities.
scope: Conditional finite relocation neighborhoods, not unrestricted infeasibility. The removed part must be restored and all66 original counts remain mandatory. Outward occupied covers may include unrealizable continuous positions and therefore give necessary area bounds only. A surviving allocation is not a layout.
